scenes.sense: A tense on-edge mood or atmosphere
scenes.description: Two adult coworkers at a desk near a deadline, shoulders stiff and faces tense, surrounded by neat stacks of entirely blank paper. An uneasy strained atmosphere, without arguing or speech bubbles.

scenes.sense: A sharp physical sting or tingle
scenes.description: A person holding a spoonful of soup fans their mouth; a chili rests in a small dish beside the bowl.
Hands tear a narrow strip from a flat, blank sheet of paper; fine fibers show along the torn edge.
A person blows a small plain whistle outdoors, with narrow arcs suggesting the sound.
